name: Biome CLI v2.6.8
body:
## 2.6.8 ### Patch Changes - [#13080](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13080) [`a68137d`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/a68137d85f375843f50e951b129e29f05f948640) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noBufferConstructor`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-buffer-constructor/), which disallows the deprecated Node.js `Buffer()` and `new Buffer()` constructors. Use `Buffer.from()`, `Buffer.alloc()`, or `Buffer.allocUnsafe()` instead. ```js new Buffer(5); ``` - [#12966](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12966) [`82651f5`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/82651f53420bdb71ec73d4470fb9bc83acb54a46) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noConfusingArraySplice`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-confusing-array-splice/), which reports `splice()` and `toSpliced()` calls that replace a single element or insert at index `-1`. ```js array.splice(index, 1, element); // use `array[index] = element` instead ``` - [#12924](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12924) [`0a9d204`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/0a9d2044b859b5fb1c651bffa6e5ed20e97d9b92) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noDynamicRequire`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-dynamic-require/), which disallows `require()` calls whose module name is built at runtime. When the `checkDynamicImports` option is enabled, the rule also checks `import()` calls. ```js require("./locales/" + language); ``` - [#12907](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12907) [`6f2635a`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/6f2635af88e671bc67d753eabed9c355c1e4ee55) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noLateCurrentTargetAccess`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-late-current-target-access/), which reports reads of `event.currentTarget` that run after the browser has finished handling the event, when `currentTarget` is `null`. ```js element.addEventListener("click", async (event) => { await save(); event.currentTarget.disabled = false; }); ``` - [#12904](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12904) [`04f30c4`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/04f30c4d45ebe4cd63ca7993d2d323e037f690d9) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noMisusedSpread`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-misused-spread/), which uses type information to report spreads that produce unexpected results: strings spread into arrays or arguments, and promises, functions, maps, arrays, iterables, class instances, and classes spread into objects or JSX attributes. ```ts declare function getUser(): Promise<{ name: string }>; const user = { ...getUser() }; ``` - [#12893](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12893) [`5d7ca32`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/5d7ca32a80f2a86c2794748aa03ada4ce9ad7652) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noTripleSlashReference`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-triple-slash-reference/), which reports `/// ` comments and `/// ` comments for packages that the file also imports. The `lib`, `path`, and `types` options control which kinds of references are allowed. ```ts /// ``` - [#12561](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12561) [`746c421`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/746c4217ba5b0d39ae696e7932ca95dadad8dae0) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noVueAsyncComputed`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-async-computed/), which reports asynchronous code in Vue computed properties, such as `async` functions, `await`, promises, `setTimeout()`, and `nextTick()`. ```vue ``` - [#12964](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12964) [`149d729`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/149d7290dff8abd6576ca2ac0364cbc50d31aba0) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noVueDefineModelDefault`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-define-model-default/), which disallows the `default` option in Vue's `defineModel()`. When a parent component passes `undefined` with `v-model`, the child component uses the default value while the parent keeps `undefined`, so the two components show different values. ```vue ``` - [#13060](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13060) [`67bc9d5`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/67bc9d5c29faf5e5c2652877b44cc99ea1a2b699) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noVueDeprecatedFilter`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-deprecated-filter/), which reports the filter syntax that Vue 3 removed. For example, the following template uses the `currency` filter: ```vue ``` - [#12545](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12545) [`0bbe4f1`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/0bbe4f1b0399f6790bd7112152178f21025b8c94) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the new nursery rule [`noVueDeprecatedVIs`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-deprecated-v-is/), which reports the deprecated Vue `v-is` directive. Use the `is` attribute with a `vue:` prefix instead. ```vue ``` - [#12580](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12580) [`3fdc987`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/3fdc987f3de1216baed3b1e87f5fe0b9ee854ef0) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noVueExportInScriptSetup`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-export-in-script-setup/), which disallows `export` in Vue ` ``` - [#13063](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13063) [`d4e90c8`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/d4e90c8ec52e4313f6fd3a6da742e41717790fd3) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noYamlEmptyMapKeys`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-yaml-empty-map-keys/), which reports YAML map entries whose key is missing, or has only a tag or an anchor. The rule is recommended. ```yaml : value ``` - [#13061](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13061) [`97aa183`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/97aa1838863c7d70618879ec96cfa0d287fd08f0) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`noYamlEmptyMapValues`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-yaml-empty-map-values/), which reports keys in YAML maps that have no value. ```yaml name: ``` - [#13062](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13062) [`6aad75f`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/6aad75fc66892ccaa9407b2eb85fd7dc09a8126e) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the new nursery rule [`noYamlEmptySequenceEntries`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-yaml-empty-sequence-entries/), which reports empty items in YAML lists. ```yaml fruits: - apple - - banana ``` - [#13082](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13082) [`c1c8c85`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/c1c8c85c8cbe4719ea5c75cca3f0f4087e0ec01e) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`useCalledWith`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-called-with/), which reports `toHaveBeenCalled()`, `toBeCalled()`, and `toHaveBeenCalledOnce()` assertions, because they don't check the arguments that the function was called with. The rule belongs to the `test` domain. ```js expect(sendEmail).toHaveBeenCalled(); ``` - [#13075](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13075) [`acfeaf9`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/acfeaf917acd1a2ef790c046cc1c1cae78e67693) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`useExpectToHaveBeenCalled`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-expect-to-have-been-called/), which reports tests that compare the number of calls of a mock function to zero, and suggests using `toHaveBeenCalled()` instead. ```js expect(sendEmail).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(0); ``` - [#13076](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13076) [`cf5b1a6`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/cf5b1a63452a63cad8fc52bd148b7a12aa2acacf) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`useExpectToHaveBeenCalledTimes`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-expect-to-have-been-called-times/), which reports tests that check the length of `mock.calls` with `toHaveLength()`, and suggests using `toHaveBeenCalledTimes()` instead. ```js expect(onSave.mock.calls).toHaveLength(1); ``` - [#13020](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13020) [`5d28641`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/5d286411d2330d925ddbb5413687f2b190aa72fd) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the new nursery rule [`usePackageJsonValidLicense`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-package-json-valid-license/), which reports a `license` field in `package.json` that isn't a valid license. The rule accepts SPDX license identifiers and expressions, `UNLICENSED`, and references to a license file such as `SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.md`. For example, the rule reports the following `package.json` file because `GPL3` isn't an SPDX license identifier: ```json { "name": "my-package", "license": "GPL3" } ``` - [#13079](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13079) [`058d7a1`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/058d7a133c354abc310a0cfceab332bb495a4c9a) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`useSpyOn`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-spy-on/), which reports properties that are overwritten with `jest.fn()` or `vi.fn()`. Overwriting a property loses its original value, while `jest.spyOn()` and `vi.spyOn()` keep it so it can be restored after the test. ```js Date.now = jest.fn(() => 10); ``` - [#13081](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13081) [`be58f67`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/be58f67ee304345e237c0c269f6a88c77fdaf99f) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`useTopLevelRequire`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-top-level-require/), which reports `require()` calls that aren't at the top level of the module, such as calls inside functions, blocks, or `try` statements. ```js function readFile(filename, callback) { const fs = require("fs"); fs.readFile(filename, callback); } ``` - [#13054](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13054) [`4d81f0d`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/4d81f0d51046b70267a27d137dd87c0ced3737d2) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`useValidNamespaceImports`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-valid-namespace-imports/), which reports names read from a namespace import that the imported module doesn't export. It also reports assignments to members of a namespace import, and namespace imports of modules that have no exports. ```js import * as utils from "./utils.js"; utils.subtract(2, 1); // `./utils.js` doesn't export `subtract` ``` - [#13058](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13058) [`ae251e4`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/ae251e4f6f92b63ccd59a0a983e072e52ad69af8) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the new nursery rule [`useVueConsistentVOnHandlerStyle`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-vue-consistent-v-on-handler-style/), which enforces one style of event handler in Vue `v-on` directives. By default, it prefers the name of a method, and an inline function where a method name can't be used. ```vue ``` - [#12965](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12965) [`c33c03d`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/c33c03dcf80abc1b0775893ca21f179e55af31fe) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Added the nursery rule [`useVueRegisteredComponentNameCasing`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-vue-registered-component-name-casing/), which requires the names of components registered in the `components` option of a Vue component to use one casing style. By default, names must be in PascalCase. The `casing` option switches the rule to camelCase or kebab-case. ```vue ``` - [#12145](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12145) [`596a2b1`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/596a2b17fbc642fca92ab6b8040314818f49d144) Thanks [@ematipico](https://github.com/ematipico)! - Added type narrowing for unwritten local `let`/`const` variables and parameters after `typeof`, equality, nullish, and truthiness checks. Type-aware rules now use these refinements in branches, short-circuit expressions, and after early returns, including [`noUnnecessaryConditions`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-unnecessary-conditions/) and [`noFloatingPromises`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-floating-promises/). Types such as `{}` no longer imply that a value is always truthy. - [#12935](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12935) [`e506ff1`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/e506ff18271f360b64396d4038e7bddf68feda7c) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Improved the performance of the rules [`noRedeclare`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-redeclare/) and [`noUnsafeDeclarationMerging`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-unsafe-declaration-merging/). `biome lint` with Biome's default rules is now about 3% to 5% faster on large projects, and up to 11% faster on some TypeScript projects. - [#13181](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13181) [`e1556ae`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/e1556ae721ee8fb90970bf4f6990d0d5d34aeba6) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Fixed the HTML formatter printing a comment twice when it ends the line of an element's opening tag. For example, `
` followed by `x
` on the next line is now formatted as: ```diff -
+
x
``` - [#13130](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13130) [`1b350ed`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/1b350ed5027da8778b73efbe99983a627a633acc) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Fixed [#13107](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/issues/13107): the unsafe fix of [`noDistractingElements`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-distracting-elements/) now removes the whole element, including its closing tag and children, instead of only the opening tag. The fix is no longer offered when removing the element would produce invalid code, such as `const Ticker = () => News;`. - [#13054](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13054) [`4d81f0d`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/4d81f0d51046b70267a27d137dd87c0ced3737d2) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Fixed [`noUnresolvedImports`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-unresolved-imports/) reporting names that a module re-exports from a CommonJS module or from a file that isn't JavaScript, such as `export { foo } from "./legacy.cjs"`. The rule now also reports default imports from a module that only re-exports another module with `export * from`, because `export * from` doesn't forward the default export. - [#12602](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12602) [`d5da394`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/d5da3946fb3a9a0b610c7cf613b26dc084d494ae) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Fixed [#12600](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/issues/12600): `biome lint --suppress` now adds suppression comments for diagnostics emitted by plugins, such as ``// biome-ignore lint/plugin/noFoo: ignored using `--suppress` ``. - [#13097](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13097) [`3be9e3d`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/3be9e3d0a45b28d2d59ca71c33d503f462e63f3c) Thanks [@ashokram-si](https://github.com/ashokram-si)! - Fixed [#13064](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/issues/13064): The [`noUnknownTypeSelector`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-unknown-type-selector/) rule now correctly accepts the valid `` HTML element used in customizable select controls. - [#13181](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13181) [`e1556ae`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/e1556ae721ee8fb90970bf4f6990d0d5d34aeba6) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Fixed [#13167](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/issues/13167): The HTML formatter no longer deletes comments that follow a Svelte block delimiter on the same line, such as `{#if}`, `{:else}`, or `{#each}`. For example, `{#if a}x{/if}` is now formatted as: ```diff {#if a} - x + x {/if} ``` - [#12845](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12845) [`e3ab04d`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/e3ab04d52933e1716ad14a04f153d5ad9f33a612) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Fixed the location of Tailwind CSS diagnostics reported on unquoted object keys. In `clsx({ shadow: active })`, diagnostics now highlight `shadow` instead of starting one character later at `hadow:`. - [#13098](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13098) [`d3be626`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/d3be626ab75ea3a4db7df9e3180864d97f86f8d5) Thanks [@ashokram-si](https://github.com/ashokram-si)! - Fixed [#13084](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/issues/13084): The [`useThisInClassMethods`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-this-in-class-methods/) rule now correctly recognizes `this` when used inside parameter default values for methods, setters, and class fields. - [#13131](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13131) [`a788cac`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/a788cac014f5972ae65e634d283b04ea966dbc85) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Fixed [#13129](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/issues/13129): the fix of [`useArrowFunction`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-arrow-function/) no longer produces invalid code when the function is in the initializer of a `for` statement and returns an `in` expression. The arrow function body is now wrapped in parentheses. ```js // Before for (let has = function (k) { return k in cache; }; ;) {} // After the fix for (let has = (k) => (k in cache); ;) {} ``` - [#12840](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12840) [`8908627`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/8908627b26d3263ec332d327297f2b347e4e3e97) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Fixed [#12796](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/issues/12796): [`useMathMinMax`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-math-min-max/) no longer reports comparisons with a `bigint` written as an expression, such as `-1n` or `2n ** 62n - 1n`, or with a `const` variable initialized with one. Its unsafe fix turned these comparisons into `Math.min()` or `Math.max()` calls, which throw a `TypeError` when given a `bigint`. ```js const MAX = 2n ** 62n - 1n; const clamp = (x) => (x > MAX ? MAX : x); ``` - [#13152](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13152) [`61924f6`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/61924f6e0766c390c681e984cb8eeca0243562c6) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Fixed [`noVueWatchAfterAwait`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-watch-after-await/), [`noVueLifecycleAfterAwait`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-lifecycle-after-await/) and [`noVueRestrictedCallAfterAwait`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-restricted-call-after-await/), which now also check the `setup()` function passed as the first argument of `defineComponent()`. The following code is now reported: ```js import { defineComponent, onMounted } from "vue"; defineComponent(async (props) => { await load(); onMounted(() => {}); }, { props: ["id"] }); ``` When `defineComponent()` receives both a function and an options object, these rules now ignore the `setup` option, because Vue runs the function instead. - [#13152](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13152) [`61924f6`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/61924f6e0766c390c681e984cb8eeca0243562c6) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - [`noVueDuplicateKeys`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-duplicate-keys/) now checks the properties returned by a `setup()` method of an options object, so `return { foo }` conflicts with a prop, data property, method or computed property named `foo`. - [#13152](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13152) [`61924f6`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/61924f6e0766c390c681e984cb8eeca0243562c6) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - The Vue emit rules now read events declared with a function type, as in `defineEmits<(e: "change", value: string) => void>()`, and event names written as template literals without substitutions, as in ``emit(`change`)``. [`noVueUndeclaredEmits`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-undeclared-emits/), [`noVueUnusedEmitDeclarations`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-unused-emit-declarations/), [`useVueSingleEventPayload`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-vue-single-event-payload/) and [`useVueEmitValidator`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-vue-emit-validator/) previously skipped events declared in these forms. [`noVueShadowNativeEvents`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-vue-shadow-native-events/) now checks `this.$emit()` only where `this` is the component, and no longer reports `$emit()` called through a variable that holds `this`, as in `const vm = this; vm.$emit("click")`. - [#12947](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12947) [`a54965d`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/a54965de793ea8e5abf0a549cd020ec688c00fdf) Thanks [@machadinhos](https://github.com/machadinhos)! - Added the nursery rule [`noDrizzleDbObjectInsideTransaction`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-drizzle-db-object-inside-transaction/), which reports a Drizzle ORM instance used inside its own transaction callback instead of the transaction object. ```js await db.transaction(async (tx) => { await db.insert(users).values({ name: "John" }); }); ``` - [#13123](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13123) [`e7c8297`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/e7c8297cf2979618655f3dcd6c28d0d0d7d25de6) Thanks [@ematipico](https://github.com/ematipico)! - Fixed [#12176](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/issues/12176): type-aware rules now select the matching overload of a method declared several times in an interface or object type. For example, [`useAwaitThenable`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-await-thenable/) no longer reports `await app.listen({ port: 0 })` on a Fastify server, and still reports `await app.listen({ port: 0 }, callback)`. - [#12059](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12059) [`87784c7`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/87784c7b9ad9e67da665687cfc22430308f17ffe) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Fixed [`noUnsafePlusOperands`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-unsafe-plus-operands/) treating the negation of a `bigint` value as a `number`. Code such as `-value + 1n`, where `value` is declared as `bigint`, is no longer reported for mixing `number` and `bigint`. - [#13151](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/13151) [`be372b5`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/be372b53483f488a47bb36b0cc11760275f2109d) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Fixed Vue lint rules such as [`useVueVModel`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-vue-v-model/) and [`useVueVOnExact`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/use-vue-v-on-exact/) treating MathML elements like `` and `` as components. Biome now recognizes the MathML Core elements as native elements, and in Vue, Svelte, and Astro files it treats known hyphenated elements such as `` and the SVG `` as native elements instead of components. - [#12059](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/pull/12059) [`87784c7`](https://github.com/biomejs/biome/commit/87784c7b9ad9e67da665687cfc22430308f17ffe) Thanks [@dyc3](https://github.com/dyc3)! - Type inference now evaluates conditional types such as `T extends U ? X : Y`, including `infer` and distribution over unions, instead of treating them as a union of both branches. This also applies to built-in types such as `Exclude`, `Extract`, `ReturnType`, `Parameters`, and `Awaited`, which improves the accuracy of type-aware rules such as [`noFloatingPromises`](https://biomejs.dev/linter/rules/no-floating-promises/). ```ts type Unwrap = T extends Promise ?
